main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
From {{suffix|en|account|able}}. First attested around 1400.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈkaʊntəbl̩/}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-accountable.ogg|a=US}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# Obliged, when [[call upon|called upon]], to answer (for one’s deeds); [[answerable]].
#: {{ux|en|Everyone is '''accountable''' to God for their conduct.}}
#: {{ux|en|You will be held '''accountable''' for your misdemeanors.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2020 April 22|author=Philip Haigh|title=Labour's blueprint for the future of Britain's railways|journal=Rail|page=28|text="Because the railway is economically and socially vital, it receives large amounts of public money and must therefore ultimately be '''accountable''' to government. [...]}}
# Obliged to keep accurate [[records]] (of [[property]] or [[funds]]).
# [[liable|Liable]] to be [[call on|called on]] to render an account.
# {{lb|en|rare|formal}} Capable of being [[accounted]] for; [[explicable]]; [[explainable]].

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|amenable}}, {{l|en|responsible}}, {{l|en|liable}}, {{l|en|answerable}}, {{l|en|amenable}}
